entity: City of Oneida, Madison County, New York
scope: General Fund — adopted budget expenditure summary
basis: As reported in the City's adopted-budget summary, headed Net Service Cost Financed by. Budget basis only; not audited GAAP expenditures or an all-funds total.
cpi_note: Arithmetic mean of all 12 published monthly, not-seasonally-adjusted CPI-U all-items U.S. city average values, 1982–84=100. 2025 annual CPI not established for this release; its real-dollar value remains missing. CPI is a general purchasing-power adjustment, not a municipal construction-cost index.
coverage_note: Three adopted-budget years verified, 2023–2025. The 2017–2026 decade is not yet a comparable series. Earlier years, the 2026 summary, audited actual expenditures, all-funds reconciliation and a Comptroller category crosswalk remain outstanding. Missing years are not zero.
category_note: The same eight summary categories are used across these three City documents. Employee benefits remain separate; they have not been assigned to departments. These summaries alone do not establish unchanged services, fund transfers or detailed accounting treatments.
